description: Combine scan + import facts into a DRAFT diagram string — Mermaid flowchart (default) or Graphviz DOT. level 'high' (default) shows modules/directories; 'detail' shows files grouped by module. This is a draft the calling model is expected to refine. Use this when you want to edit or refine the diagram source before rendering (pair with render_diagram to write the HTML afterwards). If no in-between editing is needed, prefer map_repo — it generates AND renders in one call.

format.description: Diagram notation: 'mermaid' (default; renders on GitHub) or 'dot' (Graphviz interop)

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the repository root

name: generate_diagram
title: Generate diagram
